details.name: MOB.364_Work_Attach_Form
details.message:
`MOB.364` **Attach a form to a work order — proved on the server, then deleted.**
- On its own Datadog-created work order `xohY0klBZktB9VBRxc8k4J` (work `20260910-16`), never the main
  fixture. **Self-cleaning:** mobile cannot remove a form, so the run deletes the one it attached
  over `/graphql` (`deleteWorkStageForm`, owner 2026-09-15), `always`, refusing any id the stage
  held before the run, and proves the stage's form ids are exactly the premise's.
- The toast fires before the mutation and the modal closes on the optimistic result, so the
  ⭐ proof is a `/graphql` read: exactly one more form, and exactly one named the picked
  template; then a reload shows that card.

steps.name: Navigate to /work — warm the work lookup cache
Let the work list begin rendering
The "Work Orders" page mounted
Let the lookup prefetch run
Navigate to the add-form work order (20260910-16)
Let the detail view begin rendering
Test work order detail rendered
PREMISE (server): read this stage's forms — their names are what the picker must hide and the baseline for +1
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
Open the Forms tab
Let the form cards render
Open the add-form modal ("Add")
Wait for the modal
The form picker rendered in the modal
Open the picker
Wait for the template options (MOBILE_AD_HOC_FORMS)
FIXTURE GUARD + PICK: the picker offers a form this stage does not hold (trap 10); click the first VISIBLE one and keep its name
The picker now holds the picked form's name
Submit is ARMED — `button[form="adhoc-form"]` is `type="submit"` (trap 8)
Submit — attach the form
Let CREATE_WORKSTAGE_FORM reach the server
The `Form added` toast (optional: it fires BEFORE the mutation — trap 7)
The add-form modal closed and the Forms tab's `Add` is back on screen (UI only: it closes on the optimistic result — trap 6)
SENTINEL (optional): before any reload, the Forms tab shows the new card (what the add wrote to the page's cache)
⭐ SERVER: exactly ONE more form than at the premise, and exactly one named what this run picked — asked over /graphql
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
Navigate to the add-form work order (reload: the persisted cache holds no refused optimistic add)
Let the detail view begin rendering
Test work order detail rendered
Reopen the Forms tab
Let the form cards render
SENTINEL (optional): after the reload, WITHOUT a resync, the Forms tab shows the new card — locally it did not: the page drew the cached work order and sent no read (trace 2026-09-15)
Press the page's ⟳ resync (`ResyncButton` beside `Data synced on` → refetch)
Let the refetch land
⭐ After a RELOAD the Forms tab shows exactly one card titled with the picked form (after the page's ⟳ resync)
CLEANUP (server): find the ONE form this run attached — an id new since the premise, named the pick
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
CLEANUP: delete THAT form over /graphql (`deleteWorkStageForm` — mobile has no remove; owner 2026-09-15). One shot; refuses an id the stage held before this run
Let the delete reach the server
⭐ CLEANED (server): the stage's form ids are exactly the premise's
Remove the server read's sessionStorage keys
Remove this test's sessionStorage keys
